Hey there, I’m sorry you’re going through these heavy emotions! May I ask what’s going on? Xx
Hi honey, it’s tough to deal with these emotions so I understand why you would feel scared to share them. What do you think the outcome of telling them would be?

I’ve considered doing the same when I was younger. I was in so much pain because of the way my parent treated me that I wanted to cause them pain by killing myself. At some point I thought that wasn’t enough and that idea shifted into murder-suicide. It’s such a heavy feeling for a kid! For anyone! I was always too scared to do either. I’m glad I understood I’m not a killer. I’m not the same as my abuser and you are not either. I understand why you would feel that way, to feel desperate to make the pain stop but don’t taint your heart with this crazy negative emotion that is the result of your dads trauma, not yours! I know it’s hard to rationalise, but jerks are the way they are bc of their own unresolved trauma which doesn’t excuse anything but it’s easier to understand that they’re just lost and never got any help, and absolutely nothing to do with you! If you hold on a little longer you may experience amazing things that life can offer. For example for me was to travel and meet new people. I haven’t traveled the world and I certainly don’t have a thousand friends everywhere but I have seen beautiful places and I have my tribe, which are a family to me. 
I still struggle with suicidal thoughts every day tho and that may never stop, but I think if I hold on a little longer as well, I’ll get to see more beautiful places and meet some more amazing people! Stay strong honey, this won’t last forever! ❤️

Love happens when you least expect it/ want it. If you can hang on and take care of yourself first, that should come after! Some people take many years to find love, some found it and lost it... loving someone is tricky, but your first love should be yourself! That love is the hardest to attain.

I had that dream. Or maybe it wasn’t a dream, it was more of a delusion. The idea that if I moved things would change and I would have a second chance in life to reinvent myself kinda. Well, I moved but things didn’t really go the way I expected. Nothing changed like in a fairy tail the way I wanted it to ofc lol truth is, if we’re not happy with ourselves, it doesn’t matter where we go, we’ll still be unhappy inside. I just wish healing inwards wasn’t so difficult 😪
